ptional allocation-conscious tool-result pruning for DeepSeek Harness, with independent Web switches
# dsh-leet-accelerator
Independent, optional allocation-conscious tool-result pruning for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**, with
per-optimization switches and Web UI buttons. This project is **not related to OpenBot** and is not
an official DeepSeek plugin.
中文说明 · Verification record
## What it changes
Upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` implements `measureContent` and `pruneCont
ent` by expanding each text block with `Array.from(text)` into a code-point array, then `slice().joi
n('')` on the head and tail. For a long tool result that allocates one array of per-code-point strin
gs plus two more slices.
This bundle replaces the `toolResultPruner` provider **only where its patch applies** and keeps the
upstream `pruneSession` (shadow-price events, token meter, replay). Four independent config switches
(two of them have Web buttons):
| Switch | Default | What it does |
| `enabled` | `false` | Linear UTF-16 scan instead of `Array.from`, recording in the same pass wheth
er the block contains a valid surrogate pair. Boundary lookup is O(1) when there is no pair (a UTF-1
6 offset equals a code-point position), otherwise it scans from the nearer end. No whole-string code

-point array is allocated. |
| `fastLength` | `false` | **Experimental candidate.** Probes with a re
gular expression; when the block has no adjacent surrogate pair, `text.length` is already the code-p
oint count, so the linear scan is skipped. Text *with* pairs pays for the probe and still runs the s

can. Depends on `enabled`; with `enabled: false` it does not participate in the algorithm. |
| `shor
tCircuit` | `true` | **Added in 0.3.0.** Upper-bound pruning: every code point is one or two UTF-16
units, so the sum of `text.length` over text blocks is an upper bound on the code-point total. If th
at bound is already within `thresholdChars`, the exact count cannot exceed the threshold and `pruneC
ontent` returns `null` without scanning any text. `measureContent` stays exact. Output is unchanged
and no immutability assumption is needed. Over-budget inputs show no consistent regression (the −2.3

% to +2.9% spread in the 0.4.1 run sits inside run-to-run variance). |
[该节后续省略]
## The 0.4.0 session optimization
Upstream `pruneSession` measures each over-budget tool result **four times**: once for the original
content and once for the replacement inside `pruneContent`, then again as `charsBefore` and `charsAf
ter` in `pruneSession` itself. Before 0.4.0, `shortCircuit` made within-budget results cheap but lef
t this over-budget path untouched.
`sessionMetrics` wraps one `pruneSession` call in a cache that lives only on that synchronous call s
ionMetrics` wraps one `pruneSession` call in a cache that lives only on that synchronous call stack:
- The cache is created **lazily**, on the first result whose exact code-point total exceeds the thre
shold. A session where everything is within budget never allocates a cache and never runs a structur

al check.
- A hit requires the array length, every block's `type` and every text block's `text` stri
ng to match the stored snapshot. Strings are immutable and non-text blocks contribute zero code poin
ts, so a matching snapshot proves the total cannot have changed. Pushing, splicing, replacing a bloc
k, flipping its type or assigning a different text all invalidate the entry and fall back to an exac
t scan. **No assumption that upstream never mutates the arrays is needed** — that precondition is ex

actly why the earlier `reuseMeasure` research candidate was never shipped.
- `charsAfter` is derived
as `headEnd + (length - tailStart) + markerPoints` from positions already computed during pruning.
`PRUNE_MARKER` is ASCII and sits between the retained head and tail whenever a removed span is non-e
mpty, so no new surrogate pair can form across that boundary. A dedicated test compares the derived
value against the official `measureContent` on 250 randomized multi-block Unicode cases, including i

solated surrogates and ZWJ sequences.
- The cache is installed and removed in `try/finally`; nested

`pruneSession` calls save and restore the previous state. It never survives into another call.
- `sr
c/metrics-cache.js` is the only new runtime file. `cordis.patch.yml`, `src/web-presets.js` and `src/
client/index.js` are byte-identical to the `v0.2.0` tag.
## 0.4.1: hardening, no new algorithm gain
This is a hardening release. **No optimization was added and no switch changed.** It closes the thre
e non-blocking review items from 0.4.0 and records a third candidate study that did **not** produce
a ship-worthy improvement.
- **Marker guard (S1).** `charsAfter` is derived by adding the marker's code-point length, which is
only exact if the marker is pure ASCII (it can then never join a neighbouring high/low surrogate int
o a new pair). `src/index.js` now runs an exported `assertSafeMarker()` at module load and fails fas
t if upstream ever changes `PRUNE_MARKER` to a non-ASCII string, instead of silently mis-counting. `
test/marker-safety.test.js` covers the pinned marker, pure-ASCII accept, non-ASCII / non-string reje

ction, and a constructive example of why a boundary surrogate would break the derivation.
- **Histor
ical cross-references (S2).** The 0.3.0 sections of `VERIFICATION.md` now label their `18/18` and `§
3` references explicitly as the 0.3.0-era suite, so they are not misread as the current 0.4.x number

es explicitly as the 0.3.0-era suite, so they are not misread as the current 0.4.x numbers.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and installation
- DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` is the version actually used for parity tests. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.

3.0`; other versions in that range were **not** verified.
- Node.js >= 24.9.0. Upstream reference co

mmit `fcc0ad462172522aaf5c93a7b2e01f6b9f0b0159`.
- Peer dependencies must resolve to the running ins
tallation's copies: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` `0.2.2-rc.1`, `@deepseek-ai/sch

emastery` `~3.19.0`.
- Pure JavaScript, no build step: the `./client` export points at a checked-in
browser factory script (a lazy-CJS `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` registration), and the root export
is the Node plugin. Nothing is generated at install time, so a Git install needs no `prepare` scrip
t and no `pnpm allowBuilds` allowlist. Pin a commit anyway.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`--dump-config` only proves the layer composition. It does **not** prove that a Web session actually
uses the provider; see the verification record.
